description_en: Deletes a Cloud Assistant command. You cannot delete a command that is being executed
description_zh: 调用DeleteCommand接口，并指定参数RegionId、CommandId删除一条云助手命令。它无法删除正在执行中的命令
kebab_example: aliyun ecs delete-command --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --command-id c-4d34302d02424c5c8e10281e3a310000 --region cn-hangzhou
